blocks.title: Roles, Responsibilities, Monitoring, and Revision comparison
Roles, Responsibilities, Monitoring, and Revision exam shortcuts
items: Owners make or approve major decisions about the asset or data.
Example: The data owner approves who may access customer records.
Who decides why and how personal data is processed? → CONTROLLER
The controller determines purpose and means.
Example: A company decides why it collects customer data.
Who processes data for another organization? → PROCESSOR
Processors act on behalf of controllers.
Example: A cloud service processes customer records for the company.
Who handles and protects data day to day? → CUSTODIAN / STEWARD
Custodians and stewards manage operational care.
Example: A DBA maintains database permissions and backups.
Policy is outdated after a new law → MONITORING + REVISION
Governance documents must be reviewed and updated.
Example: Privacy policy is revised after a regulatory change.
blocks.example: First decide whether the scenario is about policy direction, a technical requirement, a step-by-step process, external obligations, or ownership/accountability.

questions.q: Who is ultimately accountable for a data asset and approves major access or risk decisions?
questions.explanation: The owner is accountable for the asset or data and major decisions.

questions.q: An organization decides why customer data is collected and how it will be used. Which role is this?
questions.explanation: The controller determines the purposes and means of processing personal data.

questions.q: A cloud provider processes customer data on behalf of another company. Which role is the provider acting as?
questions.explanation: A processor handles data on behalf of the controller.

questions.q: A database administrator performs day-to-day maintenance, backup, and protection of a data set. Which role best fits?
questions.explanation: Custodians and stewards handle day-to-day operational care of data or systems.

questions.q: A privacy policy is updated after a new law takes effect. Which governance activity is this?
questions.explanation: Governance documents should be reviewed and revised as requirements change.
